name: Tenshi-tachi no Gogo VI -My Fair Teacher-
original_name: 天使たちの午後ＶＩ -My Fair Teacher-
source:
Tatsuya Shindou, the new teacher in the girls-only Shirakaba High School. He's only interest is in having sex with as many girls as possible, regardless of their age and social status, and even regardless of their consent...

[From [url=http://www.mobygames.com/game/tenshitachi-no-gogo-6-my-fair-teacher]Moby Games[/url]]
translation:
新藤达也是女子学校白桦高中的新任教师。他唯一的兴趣，就是尽可能与更多女孩发生性关系，不在乎对方的年龄与社会身份，甚至不在乎她们是否同意……

[引自[url=http://www.mobygames.com/game/tenshitachi-no-gogo-6-my-fair-teacher]Moby Games[/url]]
